raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fix KV-cache admission for `extract_hidden_states` on hybrid Mamba/MLA models. The 1-layer hidden-state group was charged at the width of the widest peer group (e.g. 24 MLA layers), so a ~5.4 GiB extraction cache was billed as ~130 GiB and startup failed.

Fixes #56774.

This is not a duplicate of #53074: that PR isolates hidden-state specs from DeepSeek-V4 MLA/SWA packing. This bug is on the uniform-page-size grouping path used by hybrid Mamba/MLA.

## Details

Hidden-state layers are filtered out of target grouping and appended as a singleton with the common page. The shared pool still sizes every block to `max(group width)`, and admission is `bytes_per_block * total_blocks`. The extraction group needs many blocks (small tokens/block), so it pays for unused MLA slots on every block.

Changing only the admission formula would still allocate overlay blocks at that wide width. When a hidden-state group is appended, split every group to one layer so the pool width is one page and extraction is billed at its own width. This only runs with `extract_hidden_states`; models without a hidden-state cache keep the original grouping. The block-outermost packed path is unchanged.

Merged latest `main` (2026-10-19). `get_kv_cache_groups` now lives in `vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_planning.py` (#61183), so the split and its regression test moved there (`tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_planning.py`), adapted to the new `_pool_bytes_per_block(vllm_config, groups)` / `_max_memory_usage_bytes_from_groups(builder, ...)` signatures. `#50894`'s `_ensure_min_page_size` (TP page scaling for hidden-state extraction) is kept.

## Test Plan

```
pytest tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_planning.py -k hidden_state -v
ruff check / ruff format --check (v0.14.0) on the two changed files
```

## Test Result

After merging current `main` (CPU-only box):

- `test_hidden_state_extraction_group_billed_at_own_width` passed; with the split call disabled it fails (hidden-state group stays merged with the wide groups)
- `test_hidden_state_group_preserves_hybrid_prefix_cache_granularity` passed
- `test_hidden_states_with_tp_scales_page_size` passed (`#50894` TP page scaling still holds after the split)
- `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass on both files
- Across `test_kv_cache_planning.py`, `test_kv_cache_utils.py`, `test_contiguous_kv_packing.py` and `test_kv_cache_config_builder.py`, the set of failures on this CPU-only machine (device-type inference without a GPU) is identical with and without this change, apart from the new regression test

No model eval: this is KV admission/grouping math only; generated tokens are unchanged.

AI assistance was used to investigate the grouping/admission path and implement this change. Every changed line has been reviewed by the human submitter. The targeted behavior is covered by a CPU unit test of the bytes-per-block and admission math.

@@ -26,8 +26,10 @@
     VllmConfig,
 )
 from vllm.config.attention import HiSparseConfig
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
 from vllm.utils.mem_constants import GiB_bytes
 from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning import (
+    DefaultKVCacheConfigBuilder,
     check_enough_kv_cache_memory,
     estimate_max_model_len,
     get_kv_cache_configs,
@@ -1413,6 +1415,96 @@ def test_hidden_state_group_preserves_hybrid_prefix_cache_granularity():
     ) == (544, 136)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+def test_hidden_state_extraction_group_billed_at_own_width():
+    """Hidden-state extraction must not pay for unused slots in a wide MLA group.
+
+    Regression for #56774: on the uniform-page-size hybrid path,
+    HiddenStateCacheSpec is appended as a singleton, but the shared pool billed
+    every block at the widest group width. Admission then multiplied the
+    extraction group's many small blocks by that width.
+    """
+    block_size = 16
+    max_model_len = 64
+    n_mla = 4
+    n_mamba = 4
+    mla_spec = MLAAttentionSpec(
+        block_size=block_size,
+        num_kv_heads=1,
+        head_size=64,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    page = mla_spec.page_size_bytes
+    mamba_spec = MambaSpec(
+        block_size=block_size,
+        shapes=((page // 4,),),
+        dtypes=(torch.float32,),
+        mamba_cache_mode="none",
+        num_speculative_blocks=0,
+    )
+    assert mamba_spec.page_size_bytes == page
+    hidden_spec = HiddenStateCacheSpec(
+        block_size=block_size,
+        num_kv_heads=4,
+        head_size=64,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+
+    specs: dict[str, KVCacheSpec] = {f"mla.{i}": mla_spec for i in range(n_mla)}
+    specs.update({f"mamba.{i}": mamba_spec for i in range(n_mamba)})
+    vllm_config = _grouping_config()
+    vllm_config.model_config = SimpleNamespace(max_model_len=max_model_len)
+    vllm_config.parallel_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        decode_context_parallel_size=1, pipeline_parallel_size=1
+    )
+    vllm_config.attention_config = SimpleNamespace(hisparse_config=None)
+
+    groups_without_hidden = get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, specs)
+    assert any(len(group.layer_names) > 1 for group in groups_without_hidden)
+    wide_bytes_per_block = kv_cache_planning._pool_bytes_per_block(
+        vllm_config, groups_without_hidden
+    )
+    assert wide_bytes_per_block == n_mla * page
+
+    specs["cache_only_layers.0"] = hidden_spec
+    groups = get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, specs)
+    assert all(len(group.layer_names) == 1 for group in groups)
+    assert len(groups) == n_mla + n_mamba + 1
+
+    hidden_group = next(
+        group
+        for group in groups
+        if isinstance(group.kv_cache_spec, HiddenStateCacheSpec)
+    )
+    assert hidden_group.kv_cache_spec.block_size < block_size
+    bytes_per_block = kv_cache_planning._pool_bytes_per_block(vllm_config, groups)
+    assert bytes_per_block == page
+
+    mla_blocks = cdiv(max_model_len, block_size)
+    mamba_blocks = cdiv(
+        mamba_spec.max_memory_usage_bytes(vllm_config), mamba_spec.page_size_bytes
+    )
+    hidden_blocks = cdiv(
+        hidden_group.kv_cache_spec.max_memory_usage_bytes(vllm_config),
+        hidden_group.kv_cache_spec.page_size_bytes,
+    )
+    required = kv_cache_planning._max_memory_usage_bytes_from_groups(
+        DefaultKVCacheConfigBuilder(), vllm_config, groups
+    )
+    expected = page * (n_mla * mla_blocks + n_mamba * mamba_blocks + hidden_blocks)
+    assert required == expected
+
+    # The unsplit pool would charge every extraction block at the MLA width.
+    legacy_required = wide_bytes_per_block * (mla_blocks + mamba_blocks + hidden_blocks)
+    assert required < legacy_required
+
+    kv_cache_config = kv_cache_planning.get_kv_cache_config_from_groups(
+        vllm_config, groups, available_memory=page * 32
+    )
+    assert kv_cache_config.num_blocks == 32
+    assert {tensor.size for tensor in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_tensors} == {page * 32}
+
+
 def test_multi_run_layer_compact_strides_place_hoisted_heads():
     """A layer-compact run region is its own dense allocation: under LHBNC the head
     groups sit between the layers and the blocks, so a run's block stride is one head

@@ -1110,6 +1110,30 @@ def _ensure_min_page_size(
     return scaled, common_page
 
 
+def _split_kv_cache_groups_to_single_layer(
+    groups: list[KVCacheGroupSpec],
+) -> list[KVCacheGroupSpec]:
+    """Split each KV cache group into one group per layer.
+
+    The shared block pool sizes every block to the widest group. A singleton
+    hidden-state extraction group next to a wide MLA group is then billed at
+    that MLA width for every extraction block. Splitting removes the unused
+    layer slots so extraction is charged at its own width.
+    """
+    split: list[KVCacheGroupSpec] = []
+    for group in groups:
+        spec = group.kv_cache_spec
+        if isinstance(spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs):
+            layer_specs = spec.kv_cache_specs
+        else:
+            layer_specs = {name: spec for name in group.layer_names}
+        for name in group.layer_names:
+            split.append(
+                replace(group, layer_names=[name], kv_cache_spec=layer_specs[name])
+            )
+    return split
+
+
 def get_kv_cache_groups(
     vllm_config: VllmConfig,
     kv_cache_spec: dict[str, KVCacheSpec],
@@ -1196,6 +1220,11 @@ def get_kv_cache_groups(
             )
             aligned = replace(spec, block_size=new_bs, page_size_padded=common_page)
             groups.append(KVCacheGroupSpec([name], aligned))
+        # The shared pool sizes every block to the widest group, so a 1-layer
+        # hidden-state group would otherwise pay for unused MLA/Mamba slots on
+        # every extraction block. Split so each group is billed at its own width.
+        if any(len(group.layer_names) > 1 for group in groups):
+            groups = _split_kv_cache_groups_to_single_layer(groups)
 
     return groups
